_comment: What each AC showroom gives a lot to work with. Measured off the .kn5 itself: the floor extent, and
how far out the walls stand. A lot is laid out to fit inside this, and the camera is kept inside the
walls, so a room the size of a garage does not get a lot the size of a car park.
capacity is how many cars will fit and still be worth looking at from inside the room. The two 28 m
rooms hold about a dozen; the outdoor scenes are 80 m across and take as many as the budget allows.
To add a showroom, run the bounds check over its .kn5 rather than guessing: a lot that overruns the
walls puts cars outside the room, and a camera outside the walls looks at the back of them.
